run_clang_format_on_directory: run clang-format on all C++ header and source files in a given directory recursively
run_clang_format_custom_exts: run clang-format on files with custom extensions like .hpp or .cpp in a directory
run_clang_format_custom_style: run clang-format with a custom style instead of the default File style on a directory
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines --path, --exts, and --style CLI arguments
refactor_main: refactor the main function to add error handling for clang-format subprocess failures
